node.statement: The exposedness problem is the finite linear program maximize t subject to h(p_f)-t>=0 for f in F, h(p_i)>=0 for every row index i, and 1-h(p_i)>=0 for every row index i, with h affine and h(p_u)=0. Its primal optimal face is the set of admissible exposers attaining the optimal value t. Thus T, O, and Z are exactly the constraints of the three displayed families that are tight for every point of this optimal face.
